title: Hometown Heroes Award Adjustment for the Pre-Approval Level
content:
A pre-approval adjustment applies to the Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit award for the Mortgage Pre-Approval the loan file was converted from — the pre-approval linked on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File, read at its level. The adjustment is added to the starting amount with its sign, before the award is raised to 500.00 when below it and lowered to the program's credit cap when above it.

| Level of the Mortgage Pre-Approval the file was converted from | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval | adds 100.00 |
| Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval | adds 100.00 |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | adds 50.00 |
| any other level, or no pre-approval | adds nothing |

**Clause.** An Underwritten or Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval adds 100.00, a Verified Pre-Approval adds 50.00, and any other or none adds nothing.

### Cases (hypothetical)

- A file converted from a Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval: adds nothing.
- A file opened without a pre-approval: adds nothing.
- A file converted from a Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval: adds 50.00.
